1.title: Smoke over Oakhaven
1.brief: Goblins have raided Oakhaven on festival eve. Hold the village against the raiders. During the attack the Unwritten Tome was stolen from the Mayor's vault, and its trail leads toward the Whispering Woods.
1.beat: The last raider flees the gate. Mayor Bartholomew rushes over: the Unwritten Tome was stolen, and the trail leads into the Whispering Woods.

2.title: The Whispering Woods
2.brief: The goblins carried the Unwritten Tome into the Whispering Woods. Archmage Elara knows the ruins and the Tome's secret. A Mimic guards the ruin vault. Recover the Tome and learn who sent the raiders.
2.beat: With the Mimic gone, the vault yields the Unwritten Tome. Elara explains that it needs the Inkwell of Dawn to rewrite events, and the Inkwell was on a caravan that vanished in the Dragonskull Peaks.

3.title: Into the Dragonskull Peaks
3.brief: Elara revealed the Hollow Scribe, who needs both the Tome and the Inkwell of Dawn. The Inkwell vanished with a caravan in the Dragonskull Peaks. Sir Kaelen waits at the pass, and an Orc Marauder guards the way to the crypt.
3.beat: The Orc Marauder falls and the way to the crypt opens. Sir Kaelen offers his blessing and a Longsword.

4.title: The Sunken Crypt
4.brief: Inside the Sunken Crypt, skeletons and a Gelatinous Cube stand between you and the missing caravan. Free the survivors and learn where the Hollow Scribe keeps the Inkwell.
4.beat: The Gelatinous Cube collapses. The caravan survivors are freed and point toward the Scribe's lair.

5.title: The Hollow Scribe
5.brief: The Hollow Scribe waits in his lair with the Inkwell of Dawn. Defeat him, then decide the fate of the Tome and the Inkwell.
5.beat: The Hollow Scribe crumbles to dust and the Inkwell of Dawn drops to the floor. The fate of the Tome and the Inkwell is now yours to decide.
